acceptanceCriteria: A work item may declare praxis.work-risk/1 metadata: change class, risk level, persistent-state impact, external protocol/provider impact, security/privacy impact, failure posture (fail-open, fail-closed, indeterminate), tier ownership and required live/integration proof, set by work capture/update flags and shown by work context.
Invalid values are refused at capture/update.
Completion obligations (design-debt declaration, verification-matrix dimensions) are derived from the metadata by a pure domain function.
Tests cover parsing, validation and obligation derivation.

members.obligation: Design-debt declaration as a completion-readiness facet (PRX-QUAL-021)
acceptanceCriteria: Completion accepts --evidence design-debt=PATH, a praxis.design-debt/1 document declaring either no known design debt or debt entries referencing captured work items with rationale, risk and the compromised boundary.
A design-debt-declared facet joins the A052 completion-readiness record.
For high-risk work (from PRAXIS-QUAL-07 metadata), a missing declaration or debt referencing no recorded non-terminal work item refuses completion (exit 3, no state change).
A declared prototype cannot complete as canonical without a debt entry.

members.obligation: Verification-matrix obligation as a completion-readiness facet (PRX-QUAL-022)
acceptanceCriteria: Completion accepts --evidence verification-matrix=PATH, a praxis.verification-matrix/1 document with rows for happy path, negative/failure, corruption/partial state, concurrency, compatibility/version skew, recovery/rollback and representative live effect, each met, not-applicable (with reason) or not-met, with evidence.
A verification-matrix facet joins the A052 completion-readiness record.

For stateful control-plane, persistence, release/bootstrap, security or remote-execution work (from PRAXIS-QUAL-07 change class), a missing matrix or any required dimension not met refuses completion; unit-test or build evidence alone never satisfies it.

members.obligation: Evidence-file digests and a release-readiness evidence contract (PRX-QUAL-023 leftovers)
acceptanceCriteria: Every consumed evidence file (dokimos-ratchet, ordo-boundary and the new design-debt, verification-matrix and release-readiness documents) is recorded with its sha256 digest in the completion-readiness record.

A praxis.release-readiness/1 contract is documented and consumed through --evidence release-readiness=PATH: release identity, the checks run and their results; release-ready is satisfied only by a consistent document whose checks all passed, unavailable when absent, malformed or inconsistent.
requirements/CODE-QUALITY-HARDENING.md drops both items from its not-yet-done list.
Tests cover digest recording and each release-readiness outcome.

reuseInventory.reason: the A052 facet mechanism; design-debt-declared and verification-matrix are new facets beside the four existing ones (PRAXIS-GROUP-10 adds group-verified the same way)
every new evidence document is observed and judged through the same reading/observation types, so unavailable is never a pass
the one pure gate; new sources and the risk metadata are inputs to assess
the one evidence-file reader; it also computes the sha256 digest of the bytes it decoded
the one contract module for consumed evidence; design-debt, verification-matrix and release-readiness decoders are added beside decodeDokimos/decodeOrdo
risk metadata is set through the existing work update transition and stored on the queue item
risk-derived obligations activate the gate for an item even when the repository policy is otherwise off, keeping one gate
existing gate/test helpers are extended with the new facets

searches.finding: no work-item risk metadata exists (only the Ordo boundary risk level, which is an external tool's judgement)
none exist; release-ready is always unavailable (CompletionReadiness.releaseFacet)
digest helpers exist for lifecycle payloads and installation records; the readiness reader uses System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256 directly at the file edge

newAbstractions.name: WorkRisk (praxis.work-risk/1)
newAbstractions.whyNotReused: Ordo's risk is an assessment of a diff; tags are untyped and carry no failure posture or obligations

decisions: New facets are added as CompletionFacet cases and keep the facet-code pattern so PRAXIS-GROUP-10's group-verified facet can be merged beside them
Risk-derived obligations bind only items that declared risk metadata; items without it keep existing behaviour
